units: Qt device-independent pixels and CSS pixels

OperationWindow.height_constraint_policy: 动态客户区高度变化时先放宽必要的上下限，再设置目标高度，最后恢复固定上下限；尺寸使用原有逻辑单位
OperationWindow.reason: 平台装饰与固定客户区约束
OperationWindow.owner_policy: Owner is optional for shell operations. Ownerless windows center on their selected screen; prompts belong to the visible operation window.

OperationConfirmationWindow.reason: 退出与重启共用确认布局

Browser.statusbar_policy: Welcome and archive pages share a 32-unit minimum status bar, growing by the same task-control metrics for larger text. Both task buttons use the same 16-unit task-list icon from layout-scale.json main.interaction.taskIconSize.
Browser.reopen_wait_policy: A pending reopen during an archive modification reuses the welcome opening overlay and its existing dimensions; the message identifies the wait and cancellation affects only the new open request.
Browser.owned_dialog_policy: Closing the main window dismisses all its dialogs and releases their native surfaces; retained tasks reopen views only on explicit task activation.
Browser.operation_overlay_policy: Archive edits retain the file page below a transparent blocking overlay using the existing welcome opening card metrics and operation-specific text.
Browser.task_menu_policy: Task rows show an operation-specific shared icon, archive filename, backend sequence tag, then status tag. Both tags reuse CommandMenuTag; operation names remain accessible without a visible text prefix.
Browser.reason: 主窗口独立密度与最小尺寸，胶囊标签支持按稳定身份关闭、关闭其他和关闭右侧，文件操作按钮采用固定尺寸与间距，列宽在本次运行各窗口共享，大小列排序箭头位于右对齐标题左侧，其他列位于标题右侧，均保留 6 逻辑像素间距，选框到文件图标槽的留白为 12 逻辑像素，图标、文件名和名称表头同步左移，关闭窗口清除标签并保留后台任务入口，包内移动复用文件行和树行既有密度，拖入高亮及拒绝说明见 design/hifi/sources/archive-move.html。CAB、ISO、UDF 只读接入沿用格式徽标及欢迎页既有字号和间距，不增加创建选项或窗口
Browser.content_preview_policy: 用户点击预览后，在现有属性卡内显示已校验纯文本或受大小、像素限制的 PNG/JPEG。复用现有卡片、主窗口与菜单密度，来源切换、取消和关闭立即清空内容。独立依据 design/hifi/sources/content-preview.html。

Preview.reason: 明确标识的组件开发预览，不是产品操作窗口

CreateWindow.reason: 保持 C01 既有尺寸与控件身份，文件选择区与添加窗口共享。7z 在既有格式组中增加一项，按真实文字宽度保障四项可读，空间不足时左侧选项标签换行。固实和文件名加密使用共享复选控件，正文滚动和固定 footer 不变
CreateWindow.header_policy: OperationHeader: icon48, title20, subtitle13, minimum height96; shared insets, long text and larger fonts grow by measured content.
CreateWindow.header_body_policy: Header-to-body gap is 0 logical units; paragraph/card spacing stays inside the body group.

ExtractWindow.reason: 原生与正文标题均为解压文件，正文与共享 footer 沿用冻结尺寸；目标状态复用创建窗口的图标与提示，保留原有路径框及同名文件夹布局
ExtractWindow.header_policy: OperationHeader: icon48, title20, subtitle13, minimum height96; shared insets, long text and larger fonts grow by measured content.
ExtractWindow.header_body_policy: Header-to-body gap is 0 logical units; paragraph/card spacing stays inside the body group.

TaskWindow.reason: 复用既有解压进度尺寸，承载真实只读完整性检查及其密码等待和结果。临时打开任务在系统接受打开后自动隐藏，失败保留并可重试打开文件，更新归档和外部拖放沿用同一任务尺寸与独立操作类型，不把准备完成宣称为系统复制完成，包内移动沿用归档更新的校验及结果布局，保留独立移动任务标识。TAR、ISO 和 UDF 的无文件内容校验和说明复用既有可换行 footer，不改变窗口尺寸
TaskWindow.header_policy: OperationHeader: icon48, title20, subtitle13, minimum height96; shared insets, long text and larger fonts grow by measured content.
TaskWindow.header_body_policy: Header-to-body gap is 0 logical units; paragraph/card spacing stays inside the body group.

ConflictWindow.lifecycle_policy: A decision window owns one task and prompt token. Cancellation, shutdown, task switching or token expiry dismisses it; explicit reopening validates the current token.
ConflictWindow.reason: 重名守卫保持 491 宽、最高 560，长标题与说明在正文内换行，禁止辅助字号撑宽内容，共享 footer 固定可达，包内添加和移动使用文件重名分支及应用到后续冲突，普通创建仍使用整包重名分支
ConflictWindow.header_policy: OperationHeader: icon48, title20, subtitle13, minimum height96; shared insets, long text and larger fonts grow by measured content.
ConflictWindow.header_body_policy: Header-to-body gap is 0 logical units; paragraph/card spacing stays inside the body group.

PasswordWindow.reason: 打开加密目录、解压与只读检查共用应用模态密码请求，491 宽，内容自适应，最高 600，固定共享 footer。打开请求使用独立身份且取消只取消打开，不创建任务。关闭会话保留任务请求，主动进入全局任务后显示。退出确认及取消清理期间暂停所有会话的密码显示，返回或选择等待后仅恢复仍有效的请求，尺寸与高保真依据不变
PasswordWindow.content_preview_policy: 预览密码沿用 P02 尺寸、字段和共享 footer，仅增加任务类型对应的双语文案。
PasswordWindow.shell_cancel_policy: 独立批次中的密码取消路由到批次取消，停止剩余项并保留已提交输出；普通会话沿用原任务取消。

SettingsWindow.reason: 设置与关于共用 612 宽窗口，六个左侧标签，首项贴齐顶部及右分隔线；侧栏基准宽 144，大字号按最长单词增宽；正文独立滚动，无固定 footer，变更即时提交。
SettingsWindow.scrollbar_policy: The content viewport uses the default Qt vertical scrollbar at the right edge, spanning the viewport; its thumb tracks and controls scrolling.
SettingsWindow.version_labels_policy: The About version-information grid sizes its label column to the label text; the value column receives remaining width and wraps as needed.
SettingsWindow.header_policy: OperationHeader: icon48, title20, subtitle13, minimum height96; shared insets, long text and larger fonts grow by measured content.
SettingsWindow.header_body_policy: Header-to-body gap is 0 logical units; paragraph/card spacing stays inside the body group.
SettingsWindow.shell_integration_policy: 文件管理器集成开关复用通用设置的共享 SettingsToggle，持久化成功后刷新自有注册。
SettingsWindow.packaged_about_policy: Windows 包身份不显示关于页更新标题、分隔线和操作，剩余区域按现有逻辑尺寸与分组间距重新排列。

QuitWindow.reason: 全会话退出决定优先于延迟密码提示，返回保留同一请求，取消仍等待全部 Rust join，共享确认尺寸不变

UpdateWindow.reason: 以 C01 创建原稿为依据，491 逻辑宽度，图标标题与三块卡片，共享输入选择区和 footer，正文自适应并滚动，最高沿用创建窗上限，目标归档及包内目录只读。用户目录路径使用系统字体，静态根目录说明使用界面字体，尺寸沿用原规范
UpdateWindow.header_policy: OperationHeader: icon48, title20, subtitle13, minimum height96; shared insets, long text and larger fonts grow by measured content.
UpdateWindow.header_body_policy: Header-to-body gap is 0 logical units; paragraph/card spacing stays inside the body group.

ShellActionsWindow.reason: 右键服务操作选择、批次准备及结果，共享任务密度，正文滚动与固定 footer，主窗口不创建。
ShellActionsWindow.header_policy: OperationHeader: icon48, title20, subtitle13, minimum height96; shared insets, long text and larger fonts grow by measured content.

SessionPage.inspectorWindow.reason: 大字号时的独立属性查看器，可调整大小，无操作 footer
SessionPage.inspectorWindow.content_preview_policy: 沿用 360×600 可调整大小的属性查看器，在同一 InspectorPanel 中承载主动预览，不增加窗口或 footer，尺寸依据与主窗口卡片相同。

native_dialogs.reason: 打开文件、添加输入与目标选择器由系统负责样式，经 NativeDialogPolicy 关联调用窗口；不套用操作窗口尺寸
